recipes.name: Salami, Cream Cheese, and Pepperoncini Roll-Ups
ingredients_raw: 18 slices pepperoncini peppers, drained, or to taste

steps.text: Spread 1 1/2 teaspoons cream cheese over 1 slice salami; top with 1 to 3 pepperoncini peppers. Roll up salami around cream cheese and peppers; secure with a toothpick. Repeat with remaining ingredients; serve immediately.

raw_recipe.headline: Salami, Cream Cheese, and Pepperoncini Roll-Ups
raw_recipe.description: Quick little appetizer rolls of sliced salami with cream cheese and pepperoncini peppers will delight your guests, and you can whip them up in no time.

video.description: This video shows you how to make super-quick salami appetizer rolls. Cream cheese and sliced pepperoncini peppers are rolled up in slices of salami for a great snack or party appetizer. It's so simple!

review.reviewBody: Yum + Me! These may not make it to the party. One tip: My salami was sliced a little too thin so that when I spread the creaam cheese on it, it would rip up. Too prevent this, I just cut open the peppers and stuffed them with cream cheese, then rolled it up with the salami. This also gives you the chance to seed the peppers, if you want, and kept the presentation a little cleaner.

I made a batch with a half block of cream cheese, and 2 banana peppers, chopped, and mixed in, and spread on the salami slices. I thought it was very good. But after 1 or 2, it was getting pretty rich...But, when I tried it on a cracker it was AMAZING! Next time I'm going to chop up the salmi an mix it in too and serve it as a dip with crackers. The slight sweetness from a townhouse cracker balanced it out SO WELL! Try it! As a dip, I'd give 10 stars. But the recipe as is, tasty, but a little rich for me.

These are delicious! Unlike the picture on the recipe page, I used thinner sliced salami that I folded cannolli like over the filling and then put a toothpick through the top. I also chopped the Pepperoncini, amount to your taste, into the room temperature cream cheese. Next time I'm going to also use some chopped Jalapenos slices on some of them for the people who like more heat. I'm also thinking of maybe using Soprasata slices, topped with some piped cream cheese and a slice of Pepperoncini or Jalapeno on it. Did I mention these were delicious? If you like the ingredients, you've got to try this. It's also so easy!

I love the taste of this combination, but, devised a way to make them easier to make and eat. Chop desired amount of the peppers, and mix into the cream cheese, using a little bit of the brine to make it easy to spread. spread on surface of salami, and roll. Same great taste, but, easier to eat!

I have been opting for this for a few years now for the app I bring to get-to-gethers. Typically, I am the one who travels and doesn't really have a kitchen of my own in the same day. I also am one person facing a big party, so this travels well, is affordable, and people always love it! I've used pepperoni or ham to roll in, but this one is always the fav. Also have cut whole peppers or bought sliced. Sliced is a whole lot less messy since you can just put a scoop of them into a paper towel or strainer to dry out. That's an important step so your treats don't get slimy or drippy. Cream, fat, salty, smokey, vinegar with a kick....not messy to enjoy, either. What's not to love?

I followed someone else's advice and chopped up the pepperoncini, mixed it in with the cream cheese and spread it on the salami. Make sure you get some of the cream cheese mixture to the edges of the salami. That way when you roll them up, they will adhere and you won't need a toothpick. They were delicious.

I don't know why I never thought of using pepperoncini in roll-ups but I'm so glad Mrs Bane did. I don't normally eat salami but we all enjoyed these. I used genoa salami, lower fat cream cheese, and a whole pepper for each roll-up. I don't think 1-3 slices would have been enough unless it meant to slice a pepper into three pieces. I tried them sliced in strips and diced and think I like the diced better. I put them in the freezer for a bit to firm them up and make them easier to cut into bite size pieces. I made these for recipe group 11/2/12.

I absolutely love these. I made these for Christmas and took them to my moms. My family absolutely loved them! My brother who is anti veggie anything also loved them. I just finished making a batch for the NYE party that we are going to tonight. 

I did switch up the recipe. I used the jarred pepperoncinis and just laid them out on a paper towel to get the excess juice off of them, onion and chive cream cheese - and after folding them in half - I folded them again and stuck a tooth pick through them. This made the perfect for putting on a cracker!

This is a delicious appetizer, and a bit different than folks are accustomed to having. I altered only the delivery method, and did not measure the salami or peppers. I finely chopped them both, then mixed them into the cheese until the ratio looked right. Served with crackers and a cheese spreader. WAY faster, it went further, and everyone loved it.

I'm amazed. I made an entire plate of these (1 and a half X the recipe) and they were gone within the 1st half hour of our get together. I chopped up the pepperocini and mixed it into the cream cheese (light). So easy. No one could believe there were only 2 ingredients in the salami.
These are great. We didnt roll ours we just folded them in half. Also we chopped the peppers and mixed them with the cream cheese, then just spread on the salami and fold over.

These were super easy and fun to make with my daughter. They're made with very accessible ingredients, we almost always have them all on hand. Perfect for a last minute appetizer or a get togetherwith family and friends. They are a great combination of salty and creamy with a spicy kick. We'll be making these often.
These were good. I still prefer the ham and flavored cream cheese with a pickle roll up but these were a nice change. Good appetizer for Italian night! Easy to make.

I guess I was imagining that somehow these flavors would magically combine to get a rating fitting of what I’ve seen. Nope. Tastes like salami with pepperoncini and cream cheese. Nothing special and not even very good.
So easy and very tasty. No changes needed. Perfect quick appetizer.
Very tasty! Thank you.
Great flavor combination. I used whipped cream cheese and added some horseradish to half of the salami rolls. Everyone ate them up and no leftovers.
I personally did not like these, however everyone else raved about them so I will give them 5 stars. They are super easy to make too so that's always a plus!
A little putsy trying to keep together. They weren't as popular as the pickle roll ups. I won't make again.

I loved it, and my church group loved it. A dab of cream cheese on a slice of salami, topped with sliced pepperoncini from a jar, and held together by a toothpick. It goes together so quickly, you can make enough for a crowd in a few minutes. It's keto and low carb! What's not to love?
